blocks.zh: 導論與背景 — 容器密封系統之 CMC 文件
blocks.en: Introduction and Background - CMC Documentation for Container Closure Systems

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 瞭解本 FDA Guidance 之法規地位、適用範圍及其與 1987 年舊版指引之差異
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory status and scope of this FDA guidance and how it differs from the 1987 guidance it replaced

blocks.zh: 掌握 Container Closure System (容器密封系統) 之核心定義，包含 primary、secondary、associated components
blocks.en: Master the core definition of the container closure system (CCS), including primary, secondary and associated components

blocks.zh: 熟悉 CGMP (21 CFR 211)、USP、CPSC 對容器與密封件之法規要求架構
blocks.en: Become familiar with the regulatory framework for containers and closures under CGMP (21 CFR 211), USP and CPSC

blocks.zh: 理解 IND 各階段、contract packager 及 repackager 之包裝送審要求差異
blocks.en: Understand how packaging submission requirements differ across the IND phases, and for contract packagers and repackagers

blocks.zh: I. Introduction 導論
blocks.en: I. Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Container Closure System (容器密封系統): 指所有包裝組件之總和，共同包含並保護藥物劑型。這是 FDA 審查包裝資訊時的核心單位——不是單看瓶子或蓋子，而是整個系統。
blocks.en: Container Closure System (CCS): The sum of all packaging components that together contain and protect the dosage form. It is the core unit FDA reviews when assessing packaging information: not the bottle or the cap alone, but the whole system.

blocks.zh: FDA Guidance (FDA 指引): 法規地位為「非強制性指導文件」，代表 FDA 目前的想法 (current thinking)。企業可採用不同方法，但須能滿足法規要求。
blocks.en: FDA Guidance: Its regulatory status is that of a non-binding guidance document, representing FDA's current thinking. Companies may use alternative approaches, provided they satisfy the regulatory requirements.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把 Container Closure System 想像成「餐廳的餐具選擇」——不只是看盤子好不好，還要看蓋子密不密、材質會不會與食物反應、湯匙會不會溶出有害物質。整套餐具組合才決定了食物的安全性。同理，FDA 要看的是「整個包裝系統」對藥品品質的影響，而非單一零件。
blocks.en: Think of the container closure system as choosing tableware for a restaurant. It is not enough to ask whether the plate is good; you also need to know whether the lid seals tightly, whether the material could react with the food, and whether the spoon could release harmful substances. It is the whole set that determines food safety. In the same way, FDA looks at the impact of the entire packaging system on drug product quality, not at any single part.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 本指引取代了 1987 年舊版指引及 1995 年 OGD 的包裝政策聲明。對 CDMO 而言，這意味著所有包裝送審策略都應以本文件為基準，而非引用已過時的舊版。
blocks.en: This guidance replaces the 1987 guidance and the 1995 OGD packaging policy statement. For a CDMO, this means every packaging submission strategy should be based on this document rather than citing the outdated earlier version.

blocks.zh: FDA 明確表示本指引「不建議特定的測試方法和接受標準」——這留給申請人根據科學原則自行制定，但也代表審查員有相當大的裁量空間。
blocks.en: FDA states explicitly that the guidance does "not recommend specific test methods and acceptance criteria". These are left to the applicant to establish on scientific principles, but this also gives reviewers considerable discretion.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 身為無菌充填 CDMO，當客戶提交新產品的包裝方案時，務必確認其 CCS 資訊是否符合本指引要求。若客戶引用 1987 年舊版指引的格式，應主動提醒更新至 1999 年版本的標準。在 pre-submission meeting 中，建議與 CDER/CBER 討論任何偏離本指引的方案，避免後續審查延誤。
blocks.en: As a sterile fill-finish CDMO, when a client submits the packaging plan for a new product, always confirm that the CCS information meets the requirements of this guidance. If the client follows the format of the 1987 guidance, proactively remind them to update to the 1999 standard. At the pre-submission meeting, discuss with CDER/CBER any approach that deviates from this guidance, to avoid review delays later.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 選擇以「Container Closure System」而非單一 component 作為審查單位？這對 CDMO 準備送審文件有何影響？
blocks.en: Why does FDA take the "container closure system" rather than the individual component as its unit of review? How does this affect the way a CDMO prepares its submission documents?

blocks.zh: 本指引不建議特定測試方法，這對 CDMO 的品質部門是優勢還是挑戰？為什麼？
blocks.en: This guidance does not recommend specific test methods. Is that an advantage or a challenge for a CDMO's quality unit, and why?

blocks.zh: II. Background 背景
blocks.en: II. Background

blocks.zh: Adulterated (摻假/不合格): 若容器本身含有有毒或有害物質，可能使內容物對健康有害，則該藥品即為 adulterated (FD&C Act Section 501(a)(3))。
blocks.en: Adulterated: If the container is composed of any poisonous or deleterious substance that may render the contents injurious to health, the drug is adulterated (FD&C Act Section 501(a)(3)).

blocks.zh: Misbranded (標示不當): 若包裝存在遺漏或誤導性設計，藥品即構成 misbranded (FD&C Act Section 502)。
blocks.en: Misbranded: If the packaging is omitted or misleading in design, the drug is misbranded (FD&C Act Section 502).

blocks.zh: FD&C Act 提供了包裝法規要求的三大法源：Section 501 (摻假)、Section 502 (標示不當)、Section 505 (新藥申請)。這代表包裝不僅是品質問題，更直接涉及法規遵從。容器若溶出有害物質，產品可被判定 adulterated 而遭下架。
blocks.en: The FD&C Act provides three statutory bases for packaging requirements: Section 501 (adulteration), Section 502 (misbranding) and Section 505 (new drug applications). This means packaging is not only a quality issue but is directly tied to regulatory compliance. If a container leaches harmful substances, the product can be deemed adulterated and removed from the market.

blocks.zh: II.A. Definitions 定義
blocks.en: II.A. Definitions

blocks.zh: Materials of Construction (建構材料): 製造包裝組件所使用的基礎物質，例如 Type I 玻璃、HDPE 樹脂、不鏽鋼等。須以特定化學組成來定義，而非僅用通稱。
blocks.en: Materials of Construction: The basic substances used to manufacture packaging components, for example Type I glass, HDPE resin and stainless steel. They must be defined by their specific chemical composition, not merely by a generic name.

blocks.zh: Primary Packaging Component (一級包裝組件): 與劑型直接接觸或可能接觸的包裝組件。例如：注射劑的 vial、stopper、syringe barrel。
blocks.en: Primary Packaging Component: A packaging component that is in direct contact or may come into contact with the dosage form. For example, for an injectable: the vial, stopper and syringe barrel.

blocks.zh: Secondary Packaging Component (二級包裝組件): 不與劑型直接接觸的包裝組件。例如：紙盒、overwrap。但若提供額外保護（如防潮、避光），則須提交更詳細的資訊。
blocks.en: Secondary Packaging Component: A packaging component that is not in direct contact with the dosage form. For example, the carton or overwrap. However, if it provides additional protection (such as moisture or light protection), more detailed information must be submitted.

blocks.zh: Extraction Profile (萃取圖譜): 透過色譜分析方法對包裝組件萃取物所得的分析結果。Quantitative extraction profile 量化每個偵測到物質的量。這是 Extractables & Leachables (E&L) 研究的基礎。
blocks.en: Extraction Profile: The analytical results obtained by chromatographic analysis of extracts from a packaging component. A quantitative extraction profile quantifies the amount of each substance detected. This is the foundation of extractables and leachables (E&L) studies.

blocks.zh: 想像一個便當盒系統：便當盒本體（container）和蓋子（closure）是 primary components，因為它們直接接觸食物；外面的提袋是 secondary component，不碰食物但提供保護；附帶的筷子和湯匙是 associated components，只在使用時才接觸食物。整套組合就是 Container Closure System。Extraction profile 就像檢測便當盒材質在加熱後會不會溶出塑化劑——要把每種溶出物都找出來並量化。
blocks.en: Imagine a lunch box system: the box body (container) and the lid (closure) are primary components because they touch the food directly; the carrying bag is a secondary component, which does not touch the food but provides protection; the chopsticks and spoon that come with it are associated components, which touch the food only during use. The whole set is the container closure system. An extraction profile is like testing whether the lunch box material releases plasticizers when heated: every extractable has to be found and quantified.

blocks.zh: 特別注意 FDA 對 Quality 的定義涵蓋了 21 CFR 211.94(a) 的「safety, identity, strength, quality, and purity (SISPQ)」。這直接連結到 21 CFR 211.94 對容器和密封件的 CGMP 要求：不得 reactive (反應性)、additive (添加性) 或 absorptive (吸附性) 到影響 SISPQ 的程度。
blocks.en: Note that FDA's definition of quality covers the "safety, identity, strength, quality, and purity (SISPQ)" in 21 CFR 211.94(a). This links directly to the CGMP requirement of 21 CFR 211.94 for containers and closures: they must not be reactive, additive or absorptive to the extent that SISPQ is affected.

blocks.zh: Container Closure System 與 Packaging System 為同義詞，但 Market Package 範圍更廣，包含了 labeling 和外包裝。CDMO 在送審文件中須區分這些層級。
blocks.en: Container closure system and packaging system are synonyms, but the market package has a broader scope, including labeling and outer packaging. A CDMO must distinguish between these levels in its submission documents.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在建立包裝材料規格時，應確保每個 primary packaging component 的 materials of construction 都有明確的化學組成記錄，包括 polymer 類型和所有 additives。當供應商變更時，須重新評估組成是否一致。建立 extraction profile 的基線數據，作為後續批次一致性監控的依據。
blocks.en: When establishing packaging material specifications, a CDMO should ensure that the materials of construction of every primary packaging component have a clear chemical composition record, including the polymer type and all additives. When a supplier changes, reassess whether the composition remains consistent. Establish baseline extraction profile data to serve as the basis for monitoring batch-to-batch consistency.

blocks.zh: Stopper overseal 是 primary 還是 secondary packaging component？為什麼？
blocks.en: Is a stopper overseal a primary or a secondary packaging component, and why?

blocks.zh: 如果一個 LDPE overwrap 被設計為防止注射劑袋的溶劑損失，它應被視為 secondary component。這種情況下，FDA 期望提供哪些額外資訊？
blocks.en: If an LDPE overwrap is designed to prevent solvent loss from an injectable bag, it should be regarded as a secondary component. In that case, what additional information does FDA expect to be provided?

blocks.zh: Extraction profile 與 leachables study 有何不同？為何 FDA 在定義中特別強調 quantitative extraction profile？
blocks.en: How does an extraction profile differ from a leachables study? Why does FDA specifically stress the quantitative extraction profile in its definitions?

blocks.zh: II.B. CGMP, CPSC and USP Requirements on Containers and Closures II.B. CGMP、CPSC 與 USP 對容器封蓋的要求
blocks.en: II.B. CGMP, CPSC and USP Requirements on Containers and Closures

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 211.94 (容器與密封件): CGMP 對包裝的核心法規條文。要求容器密封件不得 reactive、additive 或 absorptive，且須提供adequate protection 對抗外部因素。這是 FDA 查廠時檢查包裝管控的法規依據。
blocks.en: 21 CFR 211.94 (Drug Product Containers and Closures): The core CGMP provision on packaging. It requires that container closures not be reactive, additive or absorptive, and that they provide adequate protection against external factors. This is the regulatory basis on which FDA inspectors examine packaging controls.

blocks.zh: USP General Chapters: USP <661> (Containers)、USP <381> (Elastomeric Closures for Injections)、USP <87>/<88> (Biological Reactivity Tests) 等構成包裝材料測試的標準方法體系。
blocks.en: USP General Chapters: USP <661> (Containers), USP <381> (Elastomeric Closures for Injections) and USP <87>/<88> (Biological Reactivity Tests), among others, form the system of standard methods for testing packaging materials.

blocks.zh: 把包裝法規架構想像成一棟大樓：FD&C Act 是地基 (法律層級)；21 CFR 211 是建築法規 (CGMP 層級)；USP 是工程規範 (測試標準層級)；本 FDA Guidance 則是建築設計指南，告訴你如何在這些框架下準備送審文件。
blocks.en: Think of the packaging regulatory framework as a building: the FD&C Act is the foundation (statutory level); 21 CFR 211 is the building code (CGMP level); USP is the engineering specification (test standard level); and this FDA guidance is the architectural design guide, telling you how to prepare submission documents within these frameworks.

blocks.zh: 注意三個不同監管機構各有其包裝要求：FDA (CGMP + tamper-resistant)、CPSC (child-resistant packaging, 16 CFR 1700)、USP (材料測試標準)。CDMO 必須同時滿足這三套要求。
blocks.en: Note that three different regulatory bodies each have their own packaging requirements: FDA (CGMP + tamper-resistant), CPSC (child-resistant packaging, 16 CFR 1700) and USP (material testing standards). A CDMO must satisfy all three sets of requirements at the same time.

blocks.zh: USP 對注射劑包裝的要求比固體口服劑型嚴格得多——不僅規定容器設計特性，還指定 materials of construction (如 Type I glass)。這反映了無菌產品的高風險特性。
blocks.en: USP requirements for injectable packaging are far stricter than for solid oral dosage forms: they specify not only the design characteristics of the container but also the materials of construction (such as Type I glass). This reflects the high-risk nature of sterile products.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 211.94 要求容器不得 reactive、additive 或 absorptive。請舉例說明無菌注射劑中這三種問題各自可能如何發生？
blocks.en: 21 CFR 211.94 requires that containers not be reactive, additive or absorptive. Give an example of how each of these three problems could arise in a sterile injectable.

blocks.zh: USP 為什麼對注射劑指定 Type I glass？Type I、Type II、Type III glass 的差異與藥品穩定性有何關聯？
blocks.en: Why does USP specify Type I glass for injectables? How do the differences among Type I, Type II and Type III glass relate to drug product stability?

blocks.zh: II.C. Additional Considerations 其他考量
blocks.en: II.C. Additional Considerations

blocks.zh: IND 階段的包裝資訊: Phase 1 只需簡要描述；Phase 2/3 需要更詳細的 CCS 資訊。這體現了 FDA 的 phase-appropriate approach (階段性適當方法) — 隨臨床開發推進，包裝驗證資訊要求逐步加深。
blocks.en: Packaging information at the IND stage: Phase 1 requires only a brief description; Phase 2/3 requires more detailed CCS information. This reflects FDA's phase-appropriate approach: as clinical development advances, the packaging qualification information required becomes progressively more detailed.

blocks.zh: Contract Packager (委託包裝商): 受 applicant 委託執行包裝作業的廠商。CCS 送審要求與自行包裝完全相同。
blocks.en: Contract Packager: A firm that performs packaging operations on behalf of the applicant. CCS submission requirements are exactly the same as for self-packaging.

blocks.zh: Repackager (再包裝商): 從製造商購買藥品後以不同標籤重新包裝的廠商。若使用相同的已核准 CCS，不需要額外的包裝 qualification 資訊。
blocks.en: Repackager: A firm that buys drug product from the manufacturer and repackages it under a different label. If the same approved CCS is used, no additional packaging qualification information is required.

blocks.zh: Letter of Authorization, LOA (授權信): DMF 持有者發給 applicant 的信函，授權 FDA 在審查特定申請案時查閱 DMF 中的專有資訊。
blocks.en: Letter of Authorization (LOA): A letter from the DMF holder to the applicant authorizing FDA to refer to the proprietary information in the DMF when reviewing a specific application.

blocks.zh: Phase-appropriate approach 就像「學生到職場的成長」——大一 (Phase 1) 只需掌握基本功；到了大四 (Phase 3)，專業能力要求就大幅提高。同樣，IND 早期只需包裝的基本資訊，到了 NDA/BLA 送審時則需要完整的 CCS 驗證數據。CDMO 作為 contract packager 的角色，就像代工廠——品質責任仍在客戶 (applicant) 身上，但製造和文件水準不能打折扣。
blocks.en: The phase-appropriate approach is like "growing from student to professional": in the first year (Phase 1) you only need to master the basics; by the fourth year (Phase 3) the expectations for professional competence rise sharply. Likewise, early in the IND only basic packaging information is needed, but at NDA/BLA submission full CCS qualification data is required. A CDMO acting as a contract packager is like a contract manufacturer: quality responsibility still rests with the client (the applicant), but the standard of manufacturing and documentation cannot be compromised.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 最重要的一句話：「The information regarding the container closure system used by a contract packager... is no different from that which would be submitted if the applicant performed its own packaging operations.」這意味著 CDMO 執行包裝作業時，CCS 相關資訊的品質和完整度與客戶自行操作完全相同——不能因為是委外而降低標準。
blocks.en: The most important sentence for a CDMO: "The information regarding the container closure system used by a contract packager... is no different from that which would be submitted if the applicant performed its own packaging operations." This means that when a CDMO performs packaging operations, the quality and completeness of the CCS-related information must be exactly the same as if the client did the work itself; the standard cannot be lowered because the work is outsourced.

blocks.zh: 對於 biologics，repackaging 被視為製造步驟，需要 licensing (21 CFR 600.3(u))。這對生物製品 CDMO 尤其重要。
blocks.en: For biologics, repackaging is considered a manufacturing step and requires licensing (21 CFR 600.3(u)). This is especially important for biologics CDMOs.

blocks.zh: 身為無菌 CDMO，當接受客戶委託進行包裝作業時：(1) 確保所有 CCS 資訊（材料組成、suitability 數據、QC 方法）已記錄在客戶的 NDA/BLA 或您的 DMF 中；(2) 發出 LOA 授權 FDA 查閱；(3) 提醒客戶，applicant 仍負最終品質責任，但 CDMO 必須配合提供完整且準確的技術資訊。
blocks.en: As a sterile CDMO, when accepting a packaging job from a client: (1) ensure that all CCS information (material composition, suitability data, QC methods) is documented in the client's NDA/BLA or in your DMF; (2) issue an LOA authorizing FDA to refer to it; (3) remind the client that the applicant retains ultimate responsibility for quality, but the CDMO must cooperate by providing complete and accurate technical information.

blocks.zh: CDMO 作為 contract packager，若其 CCS 使用了專有的 elastomeric stopper 配方，應如何利用 DMF 機制保護配方同時滿足 FDA 審查需求？
blocks.en: If a CDMO acting as a contract packager uses a proprietary elastomeric stopper formulation in its CCS, how can it use the DMF mechanism to protect the formulation while still meeting FDA's review needs?

blocks.zh: Phase 1 到 Phase 3 的 CCS 資訊要求逐步升高，這對 CDMO 的早期開發支援服務有何業務意義？
blocks.en: CCS information requirements rise progressively from Phase 1 to Phase 3. What does this mean for the business of a CDMO's early development support services?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 本 FDA Guidance (1999) 是容器密封系統 CMC 送審的基礎指引，取代 1987 年舊版，適用於所有人用藥品與生物製品
blocks.en: This FDA guidance (1999) is the foundational guidance for CMC submissions on container closure systems. It replaces the 1987 version and applies to all human drugs and biologics

blocks.zh: 核心定義：Materials of Construction → Packaging Component (primary/secondary/associated) → Container Closure System → Market Package，層級分明
blocks.en: Core definitions: Materials of Construction → Packaging Component (primary/secondary/associated) → Container Closure System → Market Package, a clear hierarchy

blocks.zh: 法規架構三層：FD&C Act (法律) → 21 CFR 211 / CPSC 16 CFR 1700 (法規) → USP General Chapters (測試標準)
blocks.en: Three-tier regulatory framework: FD&C Act (law) → 21 CFR 211 / CPSC 16 CFR 1700 (regulations) → USP General Chapters (test standards)

blocks.zh: IND 各階段的 CCS 資訊要求不同，體現 phase-appropriate approach
blocks.en: CCS information requirements differ at each IND phase, reflecting the phase-appropriate approach

blocks.zh: Contract packager (CDMO) 的 CCS 送審要求與 applicant 自行包裝完全相同——不因委外而降低
blocks.en: The CCS submission requirements for a contract packager (CDMO) are exactly the same as for an applicant packaging its own product; they are not lowered because of outsourcing

blocks.zh: DMF + LOA 機制是保護專有資訊同時滿足 FDA 審查的關鍵工具
blocks.en: The DMF + LOA mechanism is the key tool for protecting proprietary information while meeting FDA's review needs
